name: The Praya Grande, Macau
summary: A view of the buildings along a part of the Praya Grande, Macau, in the manner of George Chinnery. On the sea wall is the fortlet of São Pedro; to its left is the entrance to the Governor's House; and on the right is the smaller gateway leading to the convent of Santa Clara.
